maria_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp verbally committed to a deal that can spike to ~5k QPS for their chat+embed mix during peak marketing windows. They want a reserved GPU floor with autoscale and a clear preheat/runway plan before legal signs. Can ops + eng price this and call out risky failure modes?

dan_engineer: Thanks. Quick q: what's the expected request shape? avg tokens per req, embed vs chat split?

maria_sales: Their presales doc says ~70% chat generation, 30% embeddings. Avg tokens per chat req ~250 tokens, embeddings are 1 vector call. Peak pattern: bursts of 60s every 10m during campaigns.

dan_engineer: Ok. Rough capacity calc: if 5k QPS * 0.7 chat = 3500 chat qps * 250 tokens -> 875k tokens/s. With our baseline gpt-like model at 60k tokens/s per T4-equivalent GPU (quantized) we'd need ~15 GPUs baseline. Embeds are cheap but concurrent calls add latency.

leo_sre: That math seems right order. For safety/SLAs I'd recommend reserved_floor = 12 gpus, burst_pool + autoscale up to 24. Need AZ spread + spot tolerance.

ashley_pm: From product: customer wants 99.9% availability; tail latency p95 <= 400ms. Do we think 12 reserved + autoscale can meet that?

dan_engineer: With 12 reserved we'd hit high utilization during peaks -> higher queueing. To keep p95 under 400ms we need lower util or aggressive KV preheat and batching limits. Options: increase reserved floor to 16, or add a routing policy that routes noncritical embed requests to spot/burst pool.

leo_sre: Also add KV cache warmup window for campaigns. I can add an ops preheat job that runs ~5 minutes ahead of scheduled campaign: `infra-bot: scheduled preheat job created for acme-campaign at 2024-11-02T09:55Z`

infra-bot: preheat job enqueued — job_id=preheat-ACME-1723456789, targets=kv-warm, model-cache, probe-rps.

maria_sales: Nice. Dan — can you sketch an autoscale policy we can present in the SOW + a short cost delta between floor=12 vs floor=16? Need numbers for procurement.

dan_engineer: Draft policy (will refine):
```
autoscale_policy: |
  min_replicas: 12
  max_replicas: 24
  scale_metric: "tokens_per_second"
  target_util_pct: 65
  cooldown_secs: 90
  preheat_window_secs: 300
  burst_pool: true
```
Cost note: floor=12 -> baseline monthly cost X (reserved rate) + ~expected autoscale burn on peaks ~+40% on top. floor=16 -> baseline + higher reserved cost but ~20% less autoscale burn. I'll put exact $ in a follow-up spreadsheet.

ashley_pm: Can you also include failure modes for legal/security: if AZ eviction + spot loss happens, fallback to smaller model (quantized) to preserve latency but degrade quality. Call out RTO for failover and expected quality drop.

dan_engineer: Will do. Quick command I used to sanity-check perf: `rps-sim --qps 5000 --mix chat:0.7,embed:0.3 --avg-tokens 250 --p95-target 400` returned queue depth spikes at 12 GPUs. Sharing sim output in the deck.

leo_sre: Ops tasks: (1) confirm AZ spread/placement groups; (2) prepare preheat job; (3) add fallback model and validate correctness tests; (4) run synthetic smoke during next maintenance window. I'll file runbook items.

maria_sales: Perfect. Action items for this thread: Dan to add precise cost delta & autoscale config, Leo to create runbook and schedule preheat proof, Ashley to add legal failure-mode language. I'll loop in account exec for SOW signoff. :thumbsup:

leo_sre: Acked. I'll create the runbook now and ping when it's live.

dan_engineer: I'll drop a spreadsheet link with numbers by EOD.

maria_sales: Thanks team — keeping this short for exec review.
